name: e-NAM (National Agriculture Market) — sell your crop online across mandis
description: Government online trading platform that links mandis across India. A registered farmer can sell produce to buyers beyond the local market and is paid online into the bank account.
benefits: Transparent bidding for better price discovery, access to more markets and buyers, real-time information on prices and arrivals in nearby mandis, and quick payment straight into your bank account (RTGS, NEFT or UPI).
eligibility_text: Farmers who sell their produce can register as sellers on e-NAM, and farmer producer organisations (FPOs/FPCs) can register too. Registration is free. Your local mandi (APMC) approves the registration.
required_documents: Name, address, date of birth, mobile number and bank details
Email ID (your login details are sent there)
steps: Open enam.gov.in (or install the e-NAM mobile app), choose Registration Type 'Farmer' and select your nearest APMC (mandi).
Fill in your details and upload your ID proof and bank passbook or cheque leaf. You can also register at the mandi gate.
Log in to the dashboard and click the message 'Click here to register with APMC' to complete your details.
After the APMC approves, you get your permanent Farmer Login ID and password on your registered email.
Take your produce to an e-NAM mandi with your login ID. Payment comes online into your bank account.
source_organization: Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India (e-NAM)
